title: Settlement Basis and the Two Ancillary Charges on a Northbeam Purchase Order
content:
Money is taken on an order under Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment as the fulfilment service's capture basis
states, in one of three ways: in full when the order is placed; as that service's deposit percentage when the order is
placed, with the balance taken on delivery; or on invoice after delivery.

| The service's capture basis | What is taken when the order is placed | What is taken later |
| --- | --- | --- |
| in full when the order is placed | the whole of the order | nothing further |
| a deposit when placed and the balance on delivery | the service's deposit percentage of the order total | the balance, on delivery |
| on invoice after delivery | nothing | the invoiced amount, after delivery |

## The two ancillary charges

A pallet on a freight delivery is billed the fulfilment service's pallet fee for each pallet moved. Goods held in store
beyond the service's hold days carry that service's daily storage charge.

## Points of judgement

**On a service that takes a deposit, what governs the size of that deposit?** The service's own deposit percentage,
taken on the order total, with the balance falling due on delivery.

**How is a freight delivery of several pallets billed?** At the service's pallet fee for each pallet moved, so the
charge follows the count of pallets moved.

**For how long are goods held at the counter before the storage charge begins?** The charge attaches to the days beyond
the service's hold days, and is a charge for each such day.
